content: Review current deploy.sh to understand pull/build flow and identify where to snapshot previous commit
Modify deploy.sh: snapshot current commit BEFORE git pull, save to .last_deploy_commit only on successful health check
Create rollback.sh: read .last_deploy_commit, confirm with user, git reset --hard, rebuild, restart nginx, health check
Dry-run test both scripts locally to catch syntax issues
Document usage summary for the user
